title: Deep learning identifies a pea-derived peptide with anti-ageing activity in skin models
summary: A deep learning approach was applied to a Pisum sativum (pea) source to identify the unmodified peptide pep_RTE62G with predicted extracellular matrix (ECM) stimulatory properties. In human dermal fibroblasts and keratinocytes it increased proliferation and migration and induced elastin and collagen synthesis, effects also seen in human skin explants. A 28-day proof-of-concept clinical pilot reported anti-wrinkle and collagen stimulatory potential. The abstract does not name the deep learning architecture or give the pilot size.
